Rachel (Finance): Team, client Orion.ai flagged an unexpected burst charge alongside their reserved commit for 2026-03-05 14:00-14:20 UTC. Appears to be same work billed twice.
Dev (Billing): Pulling INV-2026-0520. See reserved line and a burst line both referencing nodepool orion-prod-2 at overlapping minutes.
Ivy (CS): Orion had a momentary canary failover. We expected traffic to return to reserved capacity. Not sure why burst recorded.
Carlos (Ops): Exporting metering and router logs. If the router retried, the exporter might have emitted duplicate meter entries.
billing-bot: Auto-detect: overlapping meter_ids found between reserved and burst buckets on INV-2026-0520. Recommend manual reconciliation.
Rachel (Finance): Please attach metering CSV for orion-prod-2 13:50-14:30 UTC. Need to estimate overcharge.
Carlos (Ops): Excerpt: ```
2026-03-05T14:06:03Z orion-prod-2 reserved_bucket tokens=4,560 meter_id=mi-9012
2026-03-05T14:06:03Z orion-prod-2 burst_bucket tokens=4,560 meter_id=mi-9012
```
Ivy (CS): That meter_id match looks like double-count. Client finance already contacted our support. We should offer interim relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. Suggest provisional credit and a goodwill waiver for a few days of burst charges. Carlos, what's the root cause and fix ETA?
Carlos (Ops): Root cause: exporter used attach_request_id as dedupe key; retries reused same id. Fix merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/2531 and deployed 2026-03-07 11:40 UTC. Full audit upload: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-03/orion-dup-2401234567.csv
Dev (Billing): Rachel, estimate for duplicated tokens?
Rachel (Finance): ~4,560 duplicate tokens => ~$35. Including rounding/tax propose provisional credit $50. Offer 3 days waived burst allowance as goodwill.
Ivy (CS): Customer success endorses. We'll prepare a plain-language note about the cause and steps taken.
Dev (Billing): I'll create provisional credit memo but need Nora's approval to apply. Tagging Nora.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved for provisional credit $50 and the 3-day waiver. Draft the customer email and I'll sign off.
Dev (Billing): Credit memo CM-2026-PROV-256 created and applied to INV-2026-0520 on 2026-03-15. billing_note=duplicate_meter_attach_retry
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-3675 created: "Orion.ai duplicate billing - provisional credit applied" assigned to Dev.
Rachel (Finance): Thanks. Carlos, did the cloud provider show duplicate attach events too? Worth coordinating.
Carlos (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering; they saw retried attach events for the VM. They're sampling logs and will share correlation.
Ivy (CS): I'll queue the customer message. Nora, want to review and send?
Nora (AcctMgr): Yes, will review after provider confirmation. Customer note: "We applied a provisional credit and are completing an audit; final reconciliation in 7 business days."
Rachel (Finance): Great. Marking thread waiting-on-provider. Update BILL-3675 with final reconciliation when ready.
Dev (Billing): Noted. Provisional credit applied, will update with final numbers once audit complete.
Rachel (Finance): Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
